pages.caption: 启动绿色项目
en: Our school started a green project last term.
The aim was simple: make the academic curriculum more practical.
Teachers wanted to educate students about the environment, not just prepare them for a written assessment.
pages.zh: 我们学校上学期启动了一个绿色项目。目标很简单：让学术课程更实用。老师想让学生真正了解环境，而不只是为一次书面考核做准备。

pages.caption: 科学班研究污染
en: At first only a few pupils were motivated.
Then a science class did some research on air pollution in the local community.
Their analysis of the data gave clear evidence: the school produced too much carbon emission.
pages.zh: 起初只有少数学生有干劲。后来一个科学班对社区里的空气污染做了研究。他们对数据的分析给出了明确证据：学校碳排放太高了。

pages.caption: 请教专家
en: The head teacher asked an expert for advice.
She said we should conserve every resource: turn off the lights, recycle paper and plastic, and buy efficient digital equipment.
pages.zh: 校长向一位专家请教。她说我们应该节约每一种资源：关灯、回收纸张和塑料、购买节能的电子设备。

pages.caption: 新技术与小菜园
en: New technology helped a lot — one innovation cut our electricity bill by a third.
Students also developed a small garden for sustainable food, and improved their computer literacy at the same time.
pages.zh: 新技术帮了大忙——一项创新就让电费降了三分之一。学生还在校园里开辟小菜园，种可持续食物，同时提高了电脑操作能力。

pages.caption: 项目的影响
en: The project had a real impact.
It raised the standard of our science lessons and benefited the local economy, because we bought vegetables from nearby farms.
pages.zh: 这个项目带来了实实在在的影响。它提高了科学课的标准，也让当地经济受益，因为蔬菜是从附近农场买的。

pages.caption: 政策支持与证书
en: But the biggest challenge was money.
The school asked the government for a policy to fund such projects for every individual school.
Two years later, students who finish the course get a qualification in environmental studies.
pages.zh: 但最大的挑战是钱。学校请政府出台政策，为每一所学校的这类项目提供资金。两年后，修完这门课的学生能拿到环境研究的资格证书。
